quadrature_response_thresholds.normalization_source: fixed_reference_contract.field_comparison and incident_scales; no fitted phase

same_physics_and_saved_612_contract.exact_mode_keys: top/bottom x m=-4..4 x n=-8..8 x s/p

fixed_h_diagnostic_thresholds.negative_or_tradeoff: J_h > J_R9 + epsilon_J or eta_h > eta_R9 + epsilon_G
fixed_h_diagnostic_thresholds.positive: Delta_J > epsilon_J and eta_h <= eta_R9 + epsilon_G

field_comparison.E_H_relative_denominator: max(reference L2 norm, corresponding fixed incident L2 norm)
field_comparison.common_rule: tensor Gauss over the union of physical cell breakpoints from every compared mesh, including references
field_comparison.exact_polynomial_scope: affine Cartesian N1curl degree <= 6 E and curl(E), represented by the qualified cell-local DGQ6 export
field_comparison.scatter_definition: total field minus the same analytic flat air/substrate Fresnel background evaluated directly at common physical points
field_comparison.scatter_report: absolute L2 difference, raw relative difference when reference is nonzero, and relative difference with fixed incident floor

incident_scales.H_L2_floor_definition: sqrt(350000) times resolved cfg.magnetic_field_scale_A_per_m for mu_r=1
incident_scales.extension: the same incident air plane wave extended over the entire comparison domain
incident_scales.field_convention: exp(i k dot r), exp(-i omega t); code electric amplitude 1
incident_scales.runtime_validation: check resolved amplitude, n_air, mu_r, wavevector and units before applying these derived scales

observable_vector.amplitude_group_metric: complex vector Euclidean L2 difference divided by max(reference group L2, unit incident modal amplitude); no fitted phase
observable_vector.amplitudes: all complex amplitudes including evanescent modes, in the same physical boundary amplitude convention
observable_vector.different_mode_windows: compare common identities explicitly and report added modes separately; never truncate silently to a favorable subset
observable_vector.inventory: all ordered parsed top/bottom s/p modes; R13 has 612 entries; bind actual mode identities and physical wave data
power: every individual reflected and transmitted channel power

input_inventory.purpose: Root-owned static input byte and ZIP CRC inventory; execution records bind only the specific files they consume.
